verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Rovo AI features for automations, task breakdown, trend identification and connecting assets from Confluence and third-party apps to work items. None of it documents asking a natural-language question and getting an answer with citations from workspace content. Those are adjacent AI features, not the Q&A-with-citations capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
